QuestInfo.name: Beginner Bowman's Last Training Session
QuestInfo.0: You're really starting to look like a Bowman. #b#p1012100##k wants to help you with one last training session.
QuestInfo.1: #p1012100# wants you to slay #r15 #o2110200#s#k as a test. #o2110200#s are much stronger than #o0210100#s, so stay alert! \n\n#o2110200# #r#a21391##k
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated 15 #o2110200#s. It wasn't easy, but you feel like you're well on your way to becoming an amazing Bowman.

0.0: 지금까지 수련을 잘 따라와 주어서 고마워요. 진정한 한명의 궁수가 된 당신의 모습을 정말 기쁘군요. 하지만 정말 당신이 궁수가 되었음을 증명하기 위해선, 한 가지 시험에 통과해야만해요.

yes.0: 시험은 간단해요. 리본돼지 15마리 사냥. 리본돼지는 지금껏 당신이 상대해왔던 몬스터보다 훨씬 강한 녀석이니 사냥 중에 절대 긴장을 풀어서는 안 될 거예요. 하지만 그렇다고 해서 너무 걱정하진 말아요. 당신은 이미 리본돼지와 싸울 수 있을 정도로 강해져 있으니까요.

no.0: 시험이 두려운 건가요? 두려워하지 말아요. 자네는 이미 한 명의 궁수입니다.

0.0: Thank you for listening to me. I'm really happy to see a real skilled Bowman. You need to have a test to prove you're a real Bowman.

yes.0: The test is easy. Just hunt #r15 #o2110200#s#k. The #o2110200# is unlike any other monster you have fought before, so stay alert. But don't worry too much, either. You are already strong enough to fight the #o2110200#.

no.0: Are you afraid of a test? Don't be. You are already a Bowman.

1.0: You've succeeded in hunting 15 #o2110200#s... I knew you could do it... I'm really impressed. There aren't many Bowmen who grow as fast as you do.

yes.0: It is just beginning as a Bowman. You have a long way to go. It's tough but you must face your enemy. Be brave enough to draw a bow. That's what archers are meant to be.

mob.0: You haven't hunted #r15 #o2110200#s#k yet. Don't become impatient. Slowly and surely, you should continue your path to becoming a Bowman.
